To speak very softly.
Bahasa Indonesia: berbisik
Example: She had to whisper in the library.
cards.say: whisper. She had to whisper in the library.

cards.back:
To speak in a very loud voice.
Bahasa Indonesia: berteriak
Example: Do not shout in the classroom.
cards.say: shout. Do not shout in the classroom.

cards.back:
To speak in a low voice that is hard to hear.
Bahasa Indonesia: bergumam
Example: He murmured a thank you and left.
cards.say: murmur. He murmured a thank you and left.

cards.back:
To speak quietly, often because you are unhappy.
Bahasa Indonesia: menggerutu
Example: He muttered about the rain all morning.
cards.say: mutter. He muttered about the rain all morning.

cards.back:
To answer someone.
Bahasa Indonesia: membalas
Example: I will reply to your letter tomorrow.
cards.say: reply. I will reply to your letter tomorrow.

cards.back:
To make something clear by giving details.
Bahasa Indonesia: menjelaskan
Example: Please explain how the machine works.
cards.say: explain. Please explain how the machine works.

cards.back:
To tell people something in public.
Bahasa Indonesia: mengumumkan
Example: The teacher will announce the winner today.
cards.say: announce. The teacher will announce the winner today.

cards.back:
To give an idea for someone to think about.
Bahasa Indonesia: menyarankan
Example: I suggest we go to the museum.
cards.say: suggest. I suggest we go to the museum.

cards.back:
To say something to get an answer.
Bahasa Indonesia: bertanya
Example: May I ask you a question?
cards.say: ask. May I ask you a question?

cards.back:
To call out loudly, or to weep.
Bahasa Indonesia: berseru
Example: Help me! cried the little girl.
cards.say: cry. Help me! cried the little girl.

cards.back:
To say something suddenly because you are surprised.
Bahasa Indonesia: berseru kaget
Example: What a lovely gift! she exclaimed.
cards.say: exclaim. What a lovely gift! she exclaimed.

cards.back:
To say that you are not happy about something.
Bahasa Indonesia: mengeluh
Example: Do not complain about the food.
cards.say: complain. Do not complain about the food.

cards.back:
To tell someone about a danger.
Bahasa Indonesia: memperingatkan
Example: The sign warns people about the deep water.
cards.say: warn. The sign warns people about the deep water.

cards.back:
To say that you will certainly do something.
Bahasa Indonesia: berjanji
Example: I promise to return your book tomorrow.
cards.say: promise. I promise to return your book tomorrow.

cards.back:
To have the same opinion as someone else.
Bahasa Indonesia: setuju
Example: I agree that we should plant more trees.
cards.say: agree. I agree that we should plant more trees.

cards.back:
To talk angrily with someone who has another opinion.
Bahasa Indonesia: berdebat
Example: The two boys argued about the game.
cards.say: argue. The two boys argued about the game.

cards.back:
To say something firmly and clearly.
Bahasa Indonesia: menyatakan
Example: The king declared a holiday for the whole town.
cards.say: declare. The king declared a holiday for the whole town.

cards.back:
To speak in a way that is not clear.
Bahasa Indonesia: menggumam
Example: Do not mumble, because I cannot hear you.
cards.say: mumble. Do not mumble, because I cannot hear you.

cards.back:
To let out a long breath that shows tiredness or sadness.
Bahasa Indonesia: menghela napas
Example: She sighed when she saw the long queue.
cards.say: sigh. She sighed when she saw the long queue.

cards.back:
To make a low sound of pain or unhappiness.
Bahasa Indonesia: mengerang
Example: He groaned when he saw the heavy homework.
cards.say: groan. He groaned when he saw the heavy homework.

cards.back:
To laugh in a silly way.
Bahasa Indonesia: cekikikan
Example: The girls giggled at the funny joke.
cards.say: giggle. The girls giggled at the funny joke.

cards.back:
To ask for something in a strong way.
Bahasa Indonesia: menuntut
Example: The customer demanded a new phone.
cards.say: demand. The customer demanded a new phone.

cards.back:
To give a loud, high cry.
Bahasa Indonesia: menjerit
Example: She shrieked when she saw the spider.

cards.back:
To say that something is true, often unwillingly.
Bahasa Indonesia: mengakui
